sale_date_rule.statute_reference: Tex. Prop. Code §51.002 — foreclosure and tax sales on the first Tuesday 10am-4pm at the west steps of the Smith County Courthouse; moves to the first Wednesday when the first Tuesday is Jan 1 or Jul 4.

clerk_recordings.verification_note: GovOS Cloud Search portal linked from the county .gov Official Public Records page. Free index + OCR full-text search; no login, no CAPTCHA observed. Certified document images are purchase-gated, but search-result metadata (grantor/grantee, doc type, doc #, recording date, legal) is sufficient to originate leads. This is the county moat — P0. || PHASE 3 UPDATE (2026-05-21): Hidden-API discovery from the build runtime confirmed the backend is ko-search-api (Kofile/GovOS); the doc-search XHR endpoint is runtime-injected and the search is Google reCAPTCHA-gated; /results SSR carries no records. Build halted at Phase 3 (ESC-002 / HALT-002). The clerk doc-type taxonomy (10 groups, 190 types) WAS enumerated -> runs/smith_tx/recon/clerk_doc_type_taxonomy.json. This corrects the Phase 0 'captcha NONE' classification.

lgbs_smith_tax_sales.verification_note: Stdlib-reachable JSON API. Probe 2026-05-25 returned 31 Smith County records (22 STRUCK OFF + 9 SALE; 100% with account_nbr + prop_address_one + cause_nbr — property attachment proven for every record per the Duval JUDGMENT standard). The LGBS API carries NO party names; §17 routes every record to REVIEW_REQUIRED with the §17.D placeholder owner — that is correct framework behavior when expected_debtor is missing from the event document. Owner enrichment attaches downstream from parcel_master via the account_nbr / parcel_id join.

Two P1 primary sources (RealAuction tax/sheriff auctions; the county tax portal) are blocked by anti-bot HTTP 403 — technical blockers with a clear use_playwright next step, resolvable in Build Mode; they do not gate the build. No Do-Not-Proceed condition (§4.11) fired.
